import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load sample submission to get format
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Load test data
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Load training data (sample for memory efficiency - ~2M rows)
train = pd.read_csv("input/labels.csv", nrows=2000000)


# Filter valid NYC coordinates (roughly -74.2 to -73.7 longitude, 40.5 to 40.9 latitude)
def filter_valid_coordinates(df):
    mask = (
        (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.2)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.7)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.5)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.9)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.2)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.7)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.5)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.9)
    )
    return df[mask]


# Filter fare outliers (should be positive and reasonable, e.g., 0-500)
def filter_fare_outliers(df):
    mask = (df["fare_amount"] > 0) & (df["fare_amount"] < 500)
    return df[mask]


# Filter passenger count outliers (should be 1-6 typically)
def filter_passenger_outliers(df):
    mask = (df["passenger_count"] > 0) & (df["passenger_count"] <= 6)
    return df[mask]


# Apply filters to training data
train = filter_valid_coordinates(train)
train = filter_fare_outliers(train)
train = filter_passenger_outliers(train)


# Haversine distance calculation (straight-line distance)
def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
    delta_phi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    delta_lambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    a = (
        np.sin(delta_phi / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.sin(delta_lambda / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))

    return R * c


# Manhattan distance calculation (grid-based distance)
def manhattan_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    # Convert degrees to km (approximate: 1 degree lat ~ 111km, 1 degree lon ~ 85km at NYC)
    lat_diff_km = np.abs(lat2 - lat1) * 111.0
    lon_diff_km = np.abs(lon2 - lon1) * 85.0
    return lat_diff_km + lon_diff_km


# Bearing calculation (direction from point 1 to point 2 in degrees)
def calculate_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    lat1_rad = np.radians(lat1)
    lat2_rad = np.radians(lat2)
    delta_lon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    x = np.sin(delta_lon) * np.cos(lat2_rad)
    y = np.cos(lat1_rad) * np.sin(lat2_rad) - np.sin(lat1_rad) * np.cos(
        lat2_rad
    ) * np.cos(delta_lon)

    bearing = np.arctan2(x, y)
    bearing = np.degrees(bearing)
    bearing = (bearing + 360) % 360  # Normalize to 0-360 degrees

    return bearing


# Calculate Haversine distance for training data
train["distance"] = haversine_distance(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate Manhattan distance for training data
train["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan_distance(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate bearing for training data
train["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate latitude and longitude distance components separately
train["lat_diff_km"] = (
    np.abs(train["dropoff_latitude"] - train["pickup_latitude"]) * 111.0
)
train["lon_diff_km"] = (
    np.abs(train["dropoff_longitude"] - train["pickup_longitude"]) * 85.0
)


# Add distance band features (short/medium/long trips)
def add_distance_bands(df):
    df["distance_band_short"] = (df["distance"] < 2).astype(int)
    df["distance_band_medium"] = (
        (df["distance"] >= 2) & (df["distance"] <= 10)
    ).astype(int)
    df["distance_band_long"] = (df["distance"] > 10).astype(int)
    return df


train = add_distance_bands(train)

# Calculate Haversine distance for test data
test["distance"] = haversine_distance(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate Manhattan distance for test data
test["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan_distance(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate bearing for test data
test["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate latitude and longitude distance components for test data
test["lat_diff_km"] = np.abs(test["dropoff_latitude"] - test["pickup_latitude"]) * 111.0
test["lon_diff_km"] = (
    np.abs(test["dropoff_longitude"] - test["pickup_longitude"]) * 85.0
)

# Add distance band features for test data
test = add_distance_bands(test)


# Airport coordinates (JFK, LGA, EWR)
AIRPORTS = {
    "JFK": (40.6413, -73.7781),
    "LGA": (40.7769, -73.8740),
    "EWR": (40.6895, -74.1745),
}


# Calculate distances to airports from pickup and dropoff locations
def add_airport_features(df):
    for airport_name, (lat, lon) in AIRPORTS.items():
        # Distance from pickup to airport
        pickup_dist = haversine_distance(
            df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], lat, lon
        )
        df[f"pickup_dist_{airport_name}"] = pickup_dist

        # Distance from dropoff to airport
        dropoff_dist = haversine_distance(
            df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], lat, lon
        )
        df[f"dropoff_dist_{airport_name}"] = dropoff_dist

    # Minimum distance to any airport (from pickup or dropoff)
    df["min_pickup_airport_dist"] = df[[f"pickup_dist_{k}" for k in AIRPORTS]].min(
        axis=1
    )
    df["min_dropoff_airport_dist"] = df[[f"dropoff_dist_{k}" for k in AIRPORTS]].min(
        axis=1
    )

    return df


train = add_airport_features(train)
test = add_airport_features(test)


# Extract time features with cyclical encoding
def extract_time_features(df):
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
        df["pickup_datetime"], utc=True, errors="coerce"
    )
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["dayofweek"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Cyclical encoding for hour (0-23)
    df["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)

    # Cyclical encoding for dayofweek (0-6)
    df["dayofweek_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["dayofweek"] / 7)
    df["dayofweek_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["dayofweek"] / 7)

    # Cyclical encoding for month (1-12)
    df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)

    return df


train = extract_time_features(train)
test = extract_time_features(test)


# Add location binning features (grid cells for pickup and dropoff locations)
def add_location_bins(df, lat_bins=10, lon_bins=10):
    # Define NYC coordinate ranges
    lat_min, lat_max = 40.5, 40.9
    lon_min, lon_max = -74.2, -73.7

    # Create bins for pickup location
    df["pickup_lat_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["pickup_latitude"], bins=lat_bins, labels=False, include_lowest=True
    )
    df["pickup_lon_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["pickup_longitude"], bins=lon_bins, labels=False, include_lowest=True
    )

    # Create bins for dropoff location
    df["dropoff_lat_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], bins=lat_bins, labels=False, include_lowest=True
    )
    df["dropoff_lon_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], bins=lon_bins, labels=False, include_lowest=True
    )

    # Create combined zone features
    df["pickup_zone"] = df["pickup_lat_bin"] * lon_bins + df["pickup_lon_bin"]
    df["dropoff_zone"] = df["dropoff_lat_bin"] * lon_bins + df["dropoff_lon_bin"]

    return df


train = add_location_bins(train)
test = add_location_bins(test)

# Add cyclical encoding for bearing feature (0-360 degrees)
train["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * train["bearing"] / 360)
train["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * train["bearing"] / 360)

test["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * test["bearing"] / 360)
test["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * test["bearing"] / 360)


# NEW: Add weekend_rush binary feature
# Rush hours: 7-9 AM and 5-7 PM
def add_weekend_rush_feature(df):
    df["is_rush_hour"] = ((df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] <= 9)) | (
        (df["hour"] >= 17) & (df["hour"] <= 19)
    )
    df["weekend_rush"] = (df["is_weekend"] == 1) & (df["is_rush_hour"] == 1)
    df["weekend_rush"] = df["weekend_rush"].astype(int)
    return df


train = add_weekend_rush_feature(train)
test = add_weekend_rush_feature(test)

# Feature columns (includes distance metrics, airport features, bearing, cyclical time features, location bins, distance bands, bearing cyclical encoding, and weekend_rush)
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance",
    "manhattan_distance",
    "bearing",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "month",
    "day",
    "year",
    "is_weekend",
    "hour_sin",
    "hour_cos",
    "dayofweek_sin",
    "dayofweek_cos",
    "month_sin",
    "month_cos",
    "pickup_dist_JFK",
    "pickup_dist_LGA",
    "pickup_dist_EWR",
    "dropoff_dist_JFK",
    "dropoff_dist_LGA",
    "dropoff_dist_EWR",
    "min_pickup_airport_dist",
    "min_dropoff_airport_dist",
    "pickup_lat_bin",
    "pickup_lon_bin",
    "dropoff_lat_bin",
    "dropoff_lon_bin",
    "pickup_zone",
    "dropoff_zone",
    "lat_diff_km",
    "lon_diff_km",
    "distance_band_short",
    "distance_band_medium",
    "distance_band_long",
    "bearing_sin",
    "bearing_cos",
    "is_rush_hour",
    "weekend_rush",
]

# Prepare training data
X = train[feature_cols]
y = train["fare_amount"]

# Split into train and validation (10% held out)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Train LightGBM model (same hyperparameters as previous solution)
model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=31,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
y_pred = model.predict(X_val)

# Calculate RMSE
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
test_features = test[feature_cols]
test_predictions = model.predict(test_features)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
